decision: Retain the DOS 6.0-identical DOS working data declarations.
evidence: The source matches DOS 6.0 and astro byte for byte.
The saved msdata.lst places the DOSDATA contribution at offsets 03B6h–0AACh; the file then declares an empty DOSDATALAST boundary.
The 1783 aligned output bytes at target file offset 8546h match the saved reference build byte for byte.
limitations: Much of this region is declared uninitialized; matching materialized bytes does not establish their historical source initialization. The comparison uses the prior linked build and does not prove final data placement or complete MSDOS.SYS identity.
